title: Shinonome Ena — Mystery Tour Baptism?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Which bag should I take?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This one would probably be the most useful since it has so many pockets, but it doesn't have a spring vibe to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's on the small side, but this one's a nice, spring-like color. Now, what clothes match this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right. We don't even know where we're going yet...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll come up with where we'll be going, so all you have to do is follow me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I promise that it'll be jam-packed with fun surprises! How's that sound?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh. It'd be so much easier to pick out something if I knew where we're going.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I guess it is a mystery tour, and we won't know until we get there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*... It'd also feel weird if I end up being the one that shows up overdressed too...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Ena! Dinner's ready!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... Coming!
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito & Ena
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this braised fish is really good.
Where did you get this?

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Where did I get it? I made it myself.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Hehe. If you like it, Ena, I'm sure your father will too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How does that work exactly?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That reminds me... You're going somewhere with Akiyama, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? You know about that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Akiyama told me at school today.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Like a vacation?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, yeah. My friends and I are going on a little trip during the next holiday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But one girl almost never goes outside, so we made it a day trip for her sake. It sounds like it's going to be fun.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Okay, but just be careful, and play nice with your friends.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom, I'm not a little kid anymore.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, Akiyama also reminded me to wake you up if you try to sleep in on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Why would I let it go to waste by doing something like that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says you. Remember what you made me do every time New Year's rolled around?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, you're still mad about that?
Get over it already, will you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You made me wake up at 5 am on New Year's Day every year until now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I was finally released from being your personal mule this year.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So? It couldn't have been all that bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't get it, do you?! Your alarm just kept ringing and ringing...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How can anyone sleep through that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? I woke up, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When I pulled you out of your bed!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I totally would've woken up a few seconds later if you gave me the chance!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no way!

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Okay, you two. Let's finish up before everything gets cold.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fine.
The day of the trip
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mhm... Still pretty sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See, Akito. I can wake up when I actually mean to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Got my phone, my pouch, my handkerchief and... That should be it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay. I should get going.
